overview_description.description: Calltree AI, founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, is a SaaS company that leverages generative AI to optimize contact center workflows. The company's AI agent analyzes millions of minutes of contact center recordings to identify inefficiencies in workflows and quantify the cost of each action. These insights are delivered through an analytics tool and reports that help operations leaders build business cases to prioritize improvements. Founders Kun Kian and Robertson Taylor lead the company.
